bias.en: Neutral · slipped under the average cluster
bias.zh: 中性 · 跌破均线密集区

read.en: Tesla fell 2.2% on Oct 14 to $367.16, its third straight decline since the Oct 9 failure at $388. It slipped just under the 30-day ($368.2) and below the 100-day ($372.5, edging lower), 10-day ($374.0) and 5-day ($375.6) averages, and the falling 200-day ($389.0). MACD crossed just below its signal on Oct 14 and is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 5 ($357.2), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: 特斯拉自 10月9日在 $388 受阻后连续第三日下跌，10月14日下跌 2.2%，收于 $367.16。股价略跌破 30 日均线（$368.2），并位于 100 日（$372.5，小幅下行）、10 日（$374.0）和 5 日均线（$375.6）以及下行的 200 日均线（$389.0）下方。MACD 于 10月14日小幅下穿信号线，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起看多（$357.2），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The $367–373 average cluster that was support gave way on the close (day's low $363.82) and now caps at $368–376. The key resistance is still $388–391, the repeated cap since March plus the 200-day average. Support is $357 (SAR), then $354 (Sep 15 low) and $346 (Sep 30 low, bottom of the range). A close below $357 would flip the SAR and open $346–354.
read.zh: 此前作为支撑的 $367–373 均线密集区收盘失守（当日低点 $363.82），现于 $368–376 形成压制。关键阻力仍为 $388–391，即 3月以来多次受阻的上限加上 200 日均线。支撑为 $357（SAR），其次 $354（9月15日低点）和 $346（9月30日低点，区间底部）。若收盘跌破 $357，SAR 将翻空，并打开至 $346–354 的空间。
